Name: Simple Insignia - Bounties and Contracts
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]📜 Simple Insignia - Bounties and Contracts 📜[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#67E8F9]PC download available. The Android download is experimental and has not been tested on a phone. Android requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 and a compatible SMAPI port with API 4.3.2+.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Earn gold and skill XP through daily contracts, weekly challenges and seasonal milestones.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🎯 Contracts & rewards[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Complete daily tasks through farming, fishing, mining, foraging and combat. Take on weekly challenges, including village and animal activities, and work toward seasonal milestones. Your seasonal achievements are recorded in a trophy history.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Claim completed rewards yourself or enable automatic claiming. Available contracts reflect the tools and activities you can access.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54017/54017-1792244705-1200346486.png[/img]
Daily contracts and rewards — isolated native PC render, not live gameplay.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📖 Getting started[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Load a save and press [b]L[/b] or use the backpack shortcut to open your contracts. On Android, tap the backpack shortcut; reduce UI scale if prompted.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🔗 Works alone or together[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Annabelle is optional. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54016]Simple Insignia - Annabelle[/url] too and they automatically share a journal after you meet her. [b]K[/b] opens Annabelle and [b]L[/b] opens contracts.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]📦 Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4+. Download either the PC or Android file for each mod, then extract it into your Mods folder. Single-player only. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]If you already use the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53823]Simple Insignia[/url], back up your save and settings, then remove its mod folder before installing these standalone mods.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Updating from the previous standalone version: copy config.json into the new mod folder before removing the old installation. Install only one edition of each mod. Saved progress is recognized automatically.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Supports English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian. Translations are AI-assisted; corrections are welcome.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please include your mod, game and SMAPI versions, platform, steps to reproduce, what happened versus what you expected, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. Screenshots and suggestions are welcome![/color][/size][/center]
